# Andrew Sprouse

> Engineering leader and co-founder. Co-Founder & CTO at TakeShape (Techstars 2019). Twenty years shipping production software across media, agency, and SaaS. Currently building AI agent infrastructure — schema language, runtime, multi-provider LLM integration, production agents for enterprise customers. Open to a new role: CTO at an AI-native company, Principal Engineer at a company building a primary primitive, or technical co-founder of a new venture.

This site is the public source of truth for Andrew's career, technical work, and opinions. It includes three archetype-anchored landing pages, an in-page chatbot grounded in an authored Q&A corpus, and a documented methodology page.

## Landing pages

- [CTO archetype](https://sprouse.dev/): Andrew framed as CTO at an AI-native company
- [Principal Engineer archetype](https://sprouse.dev/principal): Andrew framed as Principal at a company whose product is a primary primitive (LLM, runtime, commerce backbone)
- [Co-founder archetype](https://sprouse.dev/cofounder): Andrew framed as technical co-founder, application-first

## Methodology

- [About the chatbot](https://sprouse.dev/about-the-bot): How the in-page chatbot was built — Q&A corpus, BM25 retrieval, persona prompt, corpus stats
